column1: # EVERY RECORD OF THIS FAMILY IN FAMILYSEARCH'S SOUTH AFRICAN HOLDINGS — 17 September 2026.
# Surname WEAR, matched EXACTLY (q.surname.exact=on), country South Africa: 111 records, all read.
# Surname LUWINSKI, matched exactly: 2. Surname FIGUEIREDO, matched exactly: 24.
# Leonard was also searched under WARE, WEIR, WIER, WEARE, WEARNE and WEARS. He is under none of them.

column7: NEW, and it explains a case name. WLD 790/1957 is "Leonard Aubrey Robert Wear versus Phyllis Agnes NORQUOY" — the archive had her new surname from the index and no idea where it came from. She remarried on 14 June 1952, seven and a half months after Leonard did. Her birth year, 1915, is the same in both her marriages.

column6: South Africa, Church of the Province of South Africa (Anglican) Parish Registers — ark 1:1:6ZPY-XHSZ
column7: NEW AS A RECORD. The marriage was known only from GenDatabase, which is a transcription. This is the parish register, and it is ANGLICAN — the first documentary evidence of this family's denomination in South Africa. It also confirms independently that Kathleen was in Johannesburg by 1945.

THE NEGATIVE, NOW MEASURED ACROSS ALL THIRTY-TWO COLLECTIONS RATHER THAN ONE. He appears in FamilySearch's South African holdings EXACTLY TWICE, and both are marriages. No death, no burial, no estate, under his own surname or six variants of it.
Kurt appears EXACTLY TWICE, and both are marriages. See the two index cliffs in familysearch-south-africa.tsv: the civil death index stops in 1966 and he died after it.
Three marriages and nothing else. Her parents' names remain the oldest unanswered question in this archive; no South African set FamilySearch holds carries a parents' column for a civil marriage.

column7: NOT OURS. A different Leonard Wear with a different middle name in a different province. Her parents are Andries Hercules Ferreira and Susannah C. Ströh. Written down before it costs somebody an afternoon.
